mentions.name: Gaming Couch third-party development tools
mentions.description: Third-party development tools for the Gaming Couch platform, being built so that anyone can make simple and fun multiplayer party games for the platform, ideally in only one weekend. Interested game devs are invited to beta test the dev tools via the website, Discord, or email.
mentions.source_excerpt: At the moment working on the 3rd party development tools so in the future anyone can make their game dev dreams a reality and make a simple and fun multiplayer party game for the Gaming Couch platform, ideally in only one weekend!
